title: The Signature Schema Archives Database — Overview: schemas for the writing system
body: Signature edition. Signature schema governance, labeled Signature throughout. Every database in the writing system speaks a schema: the shape its records must take. This database archives those schemas as machine-readable JSON Schema documents, so validators, generators, and merger tools can check compliance automatically. Each record below carries one schema in full. The demos validate real sample objects against these schemas — executed, asserted, recorded.
capabilities: Publish the schema for every record type

million_march.note: Every database marches toward a million records; this seed set is the verified foundation.

generator.note: Hard stop at ONE QUADRILLION (10^15) records OR when genuinely complete, whichever comes first. Ladder: simple → most competitive → mix-and-match → unmade → top-notch or better → future grade → God mode. Throttled so it never overloads the host.
